bad ka la kham pynbun ruh ki nongmihkhmat ba la jied da ki paidbah bad ka kham ai bor ruh ia ka, h3mTei ym shym ai pat ia ka bor ban 'control' ia ka 'Executive'. Wat la ka rukom synshar ha ki British Areas ha ri India ka dei ka Unitary Form of Government ha kaba ka bor baroh ka shong ha ka Sorkar pdeng, hynrei na ka bynta ban kham lah ban p)nniaid kham bha ia ki kam ha ki Provinces, ka la don ka jingbate ia ki bor thaw ain bad bor pyniaid kam hapdeng ka Centre bad ki Provinces. La buh ha ka Centre ia ki Subjects kum ka Defence, Foreign Relations, Railway, Posts bad Telegraphs Currency bad coinage, Tariffe bad Customs, Public Debts, Civil bad Criminal Laws and procedure. Shipping, Major Ports etc., ki subjects ha kiba donkam ban ioh kajuh ka rukom pyniaid ha baroh kawei ka ri India. Ki Subjects jong ki Provinces pat ki long kum ka Local self- government, Education, Medical amdinistration bad Public Health, Agriculture, Industry bad Revenue, Irrigation, Forests, Administration of Justice, Police bad Jails, etc., ki subjects kiba ka jingdonkam ka iapher na kawei ka Province sha kawei ka Province. Ka 'Residuary power' ne ka bor ban thaw ain ha ki Subjects kiba ym shym don jingiasam ka shong ha ka Centre. Kane ka jingp3miabynta ia ki Subjects hapdeng ka Centre bad ki Province ka shu long tang na ka bynta ka jingiaid belt ka jingpyniaid kam bad kam dei ka jingphiah ia ka bor jong ka Centre, kaba, lada donkam, ka lah ban shimti lut ia baroh ki bor. ka Unitary Form of Government. la ki Subjects bad rukom pyniaid kam ha ki Provinces ruh la phiah ha ki ar bynta. Ki daw kiba kongsan kiba la pynlong ia ki 'riew rangbah ha kito ki por ban seng ia ka Khasi National Dorbar ki paw ha ka "SHITHI BAD NOTIS" kaba la shon bad phah sha ki briew ha kito ki por ban iawer ha ki ban iawan sha katei ka jingialang. Ka Shithi bad Notis ka long kumne harum "SHITHI BAD NOTIS" 27-7-23 KO PARALOK RANGBAH NE NONGSYNSHAR Ngi thoh ha phi mynta shaphang ka kam kaba donkam eh kaba ki Syiem, ki Wadar, ki Lyngdoh bad ki Sirdar ki Myntri bad ki Rangbah pyrkhat baroh ki dei ban kit khia da ka buit, da ka bor bad ha ka dohnud baroh. Phi tip mynta ha kane ka ri India don ka jingkhih bad jingialeh kaba jur ba ki Nong-India hi kin ioh synshar ia la ka ri. Naduh u snem 1921 ka jingsynshar ia kane ka ri India Jong ngi da ka Sorkar Bilat ka la sdang ban kylla. la kane ka jingsdang ka jingkylla ha ka jingsynshar la khot ka Reformed Government (Ka synshar Sorkar ba la pynthymmai). Ha kane ka jingsynshar ba la sdang thymmai bun ki nong-India ki la sdang ban shim ia ka jaka ki Phareng. Te katba ki snem ki nangmih ki Phareng kin nang duna,

bad kin kham bun ki Nong-India ki ban long ki nongsynshar bad ki Lat. Lehse hapdeng shiphew snem naduh mynta kin bun shibun eh ki Nong-India ki ban shim ia ka jaka ki Phareng. Te lada kane ka jingsynshar ba thymmai kan iai iaid hapdeng ki arphew snem lehse kham niar ban shem Phareng ha ki kyrdan jingsynshar ba halor, ka lah ban long kin ym don shtih. Bad kiwei kiwei ki paitbah. 30"' September 1925 Ki Kam La tyrwa da u Vice-President bad mynjur da ka Dorbar ba namar ba u President um pat poi, I join Manik Syiem Sohra in nangshim ia ka kam President ban da wan poi u President. 1 . Ka Report jong u Secretary President, rangbah bad paitbah baroh, nga sngewbha ban ai la kane ka report shaphang ki kam jong ka National Dorbar Naduh katei ka Dorbar kaba lai ka Executive Committee ka la trei katto katne ki kam kiba don kam. Ngi la pyrkhat lad kumno ban pynsted ia ka jingtrei jong ka Dorbar. Kumba la rai ha ka dorbar ba la lah ngi la phah ia ki Proceedings jong ka dorbar ha ki Syiem bad ki hima baroh, bad ngi la thoh da ki shithi ba kin ia pynlong dorbar bad kin ia ai jingmut shapahng ki ain artylli kiba la thoh bad ngi la ong de ia ki ba kin ia phah briew ban iashem bad ka Eksekiwtib Komiti. Ha ka 28 bad 29 tarik September de ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la ialang biang ban iashem bad kiba ngi la khot ban wan na ki hima bad ioh ia pynbeit ia ki Ain artylli - ka Ain jinglong-

79 khun-ka hima bad ka Ain bri khyndew; bad ngi la ialeh katba lah ban pynbeit. Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la ia wad jingtip de shaphang ka Ain Jingioh-pateng ha ri Khasi; bad ngi la pyrkhat ruh ban iathoh noh ia kane ka Ain bad ka Ain jingiateh hima (constitution). Ngi kyrmen na ka jingtip ba ngi lah ban lum ha kane ka Dorbar ngin lah ban pynmih ha ka jingthoh la kine ki am ha kawei pat ka dorbar ka ban sa long. Kane ka jingthoh ia kine ki Ain ka long ka kam baneh ba ngi ia trei; bad kine ki jingthoh kin long ki ain jong ka ri. Ka nongrim ba ngi trei hadien kan skhem haba ngi la dep ban thoh ia kine ki ain baroh. Kawei na ki kam kaba ngi la sngewkhia ha kane ka por ka long ka plan jong ka ling Dorbar kaba ngin thaw ha Mawkhar. Ha ka dorbar ba la lah ngi la shimti ia ka jaka ba khot National Hall ha Mawkhar. Kumta ka jaka ban thaw la ka Ing-dorbar ngi la don lupa. Nalor kata ruh u Rai Sahib Hormu Rai Diengdoh u la pyntip ha ngi ba don kumba 4 ne 5 spah tyngka ba la ioh na ka bai wai iing ka National Hall, bad la kine ki tyngka i sa ai ha ka National Dorbar namar ka ling Dorbar. la kane in sa kren hi haba ngin la kren shaphang ka plan bad ka estimate ne ka jingkhein antad ia ka jinglut Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la khein ba ka jinglut kan long tang Rs. 11,000. Bad ngin sa ia kren hangne shaphang kane, bad

lada ka dorbar ka pynskhem ia kane te ngin ia thaw lad kumno ban pynmih ia kine ki tyngka. Ngi kyrmen ha kane ka dorbar ba ngin lah ban pynkut ia ka Ain jinglong-khun-ka-hima, bad ngin ioh jingtip shuh shaphang ka Ain-bri-khyndew. Ka don sa kawei ka jingpyrkhat jong ka Eksekiwtib Komiti kaba ngi la sngew ba ka long kaba donkam eh. Kane ka long ba ngin jied amgut ki rangbah ban phah kylleng ha ki hima ban ai lekshor bad ban wad jingtip shaphang ka rukom jongioh pateng, shaphang ka jingiateh hima bad shaphang kiwei kiwei de. Ngi mut ban thoh na ka Eksekiwtib Komiti 80 bun ki jingkylli ba kine ki rangbah kiba phah sha ki hima kin kylli na ki rangbah ki hima baroh bad kin thoh ia ka jubab jong ki, bad nangta ngin sa ia thoh beit kat kita ki jingtip ia ki rukom ban long ki ain kiba neh. Ka Dorbar kan jied ia kine ki rangbah lada ka ia mynjur ban phah ia ki namar kine ki kam. Bad sa kawei pat, kine ki rangbah kin pynsngewthuh ia ki paitbah ia ka jingdonkam ban long member ha kane ka Dorbar bad kin phah soi ia ki kot member. Bad kin kren de shaphang ka ling Dorbar ba kin ialeh ban pynkhih ia ki paitbah ka ri ban ia ai synniang namar kane ka ling Dorbar. Nga hi nga sngew ba ka long kaba donkam eh ba ngin phah rangbah kumne. Lada ka Dorbar kan mynjur ia kane te kan

ai ruh katto katne tyngka ban siew ia ka jinglut jong kine ki ban leit kumne kylleng ha ka hima Khasi. Bad lehse kata ka tyngka kan ym duna ia ka Rs. 250. Te hynrei kane ka jinglut ka lah ban mih na ki tyngka ban ioh na ki hima na kiba long member bad na kiba ia synniang ia ka ling Dorbar. Nga kyrmen ba phm ia buh jingmut shaphang kane ha kane ka Dorbar. Ia ka jingioh bad jinglut mynta ka snem kat kaba la ai U Treasure la buh hadien (Appendix A). Shuwa ba ngan wai noh nga sngew nga donkam khyndiat ban kren. Nga iohi ba kane ka Dorbar ka la nang-roi nagskhem bad ki paitbah ka ri ki nangkhmih ha ka ia kiei-kiei kiba bha ki ban nangmih hadien. Ki briew kiba artatien ki la nang sngew shngain. Ki briew ki ban trei ha ka Dorbar ruh ngi ioh-i ki nangmih. Ngi donkam mynta tang ba ngin ia pynsngewthuh paralok ia ka jingdonkam kane ka Dorbar. Kat shaba ngi leit ngi dei ban kyntu ia ki paitbah ban ia soi ia ki phorm member. Ngi kum ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ngi pyrkhat ban pynkylla katto katne na ki rul jong ka Dorbar. la kine ki ml ngi shem ha ki Proceedings kiba ha ka dorbar ba nyngkong. la kine ki jingpynkylla ngin sa iathuh ynda ngi la poi ban kren shaphang kane. 81 Khatduh eh, nga sngewnguh shibun ia ki Syiem bad ki

nongs)mshar kiba la ia kit khia ban wan poi ha kane ka dorbar Ka jingsngewhun jong u paitbah ka long kaba khraw haba ki ia wan kumne. Nichols-Roy - Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la thaw ia ka plan bad ia ka estimate (Jingkhein ia ka jinglut) na ka bynta ban thaw ia ka ling-Dorbar ha Mawkhar. La khein ba ka jinglut kan ym duna ia ka Rs. 11,000 (Khadwei hajar tyngka). Lada ki hima baroh kin kitkhia shaphang kane kan ym long kaba eh ba yn pynmih katne 64 na ka bynta ka ling Dorbar. Don ruh kiba ong ba lada yn pynlut tang katne ka ling Dorbar kan nym pat iaryngkat kat ka burom jong ka Ri Khasi. Don kiba ong ruh la kumno kumno ruh dei ban pynlut haduh Rs. 15/000 bad wad kane ruh ki ong ba ka dang rit shibun. Mr. Chandra Nath Roy - Mynta haba ngi ia long Dorbar ngi ioh ia ka iing tang na kiwei, hynrei ngi sngew ba ka Dorbar ka dei ban ioh hi ia la ka jong ka ling Dorbar, namar ka long kaba jah burom ia ka Ri Khasi ba kat ki hima Khasi kin shu iapan iing man la ka teng ba long

dorbar. Lada ki Syiem, ki Lyngdoh, Wadar, Sordar bad baroh ngi ia kitkhia kam long kaba eh ban pynmih Rs. 11,000 kumba la khein ka Eksekiwtib Komiti. Siem Joinmanik Sohra - Ngi ia don baroh laiphew Siem ha ri Khasi bad lada ngi kitkhia hi kan nym long kaba eh ban ia pynmih ia kane ka khadwei hajar tyngka. Kane ka long ban pyndonburom bad ban pynkyntiew ia la ka ri, kumta nga k)mtu ia phi ki para Siem, Lyngdoh, Wadar bad Sordar bad ki rangbah paw khmat ka ri ba phin sngewbha ban ia kitkhia. U Suba Singh, Nonglait - Don bun ki briew kiba ia pynlut bun tyngka na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba itynnad. Hynrei kane kaba ngi iakren mynta ka long na ka bynta ban pyndon burom ia la ka ri. Hato kam long mo kaba ngi dei eh ban ia kit khia shaphang kane haba ngi iohi ba kaba ngi pynlut ha kaba thaw ia ka iing dorbar, ka long ym na ka bynta ka jingpynbyrngia bad jingpynitynnad hinrei na ka bynta ban pyndon burom ia la ka ri. Nga mynjur ban ia pynmih ia kane ka khadwei hajar tyngka mynta ngin ia nang pynkhraw pat hadien. Nga ia mynjur lem ia ka jmgong I Siem Sohra ba lada ki Siem, ki Lyngdoh, ki Wadar bad Sordar baroh kin ia kit khia kan nym long kaba eh ban pynmih ia kane ka tyngka, hinrei lada kine ki nongsynshar kim mon ban kit khia te ka long ka jingeh.

U Samoi Lawmei - Lada ki Siem, Wadar bad Sordar baroh ki ia sngewthuh ia kane ka jingdonkam kaba 86 khraw na ka bynta ban pyndonburom ia ka ri ki dei la kumno kumno ban ia kit khia ban ia p)nimih pisa ha la ki hima lymda kumta te kan long ka jingeh. U Lum S3mtiew Laitzyngew - Kine ki jingkren baroh ki long kiba shongnia. Lada kine ki Syiem, Lyngdoh, Wadar bad Sordar ki ia kit khia hi yn ym don jingeh banpynmih ia kaen ka jingdonkam. Ngi dap da ka jingsngewnguh kaba khraw ia kito ki Siem bad Nongsynshar kiba la Sian bad sngewthuh ia kane ka jingdonkam kaba khraw bad kiba la kit khia ruh. Mr. Sib Charan Roy - Ym dei ban ngin shu pynkit tang ha ki Siem wat tang katne ba la pynkit ruh ki la khia eh. Hynrei man la uwei pa uwei baroh u dei ban sngewthuh ba ka long la ka jong bad na kata uwei pa uwei u dei ban kit khia. Dei ma phi ki paitbah kiba dei ban trei bad kit ia kane baroh. Lada phi hi phi la sngewthuh ia kane ka jingdonkam ban pyndonburom ia la ka ri, dei ma phi ki ban ialeh katba don la ka bor bad ban ia kyntu de para khun ka ri baroh ban ia trei lem bad pynmih peisa. Lada phi ong ba phi ia ioh jingshai dei ma phi ki ban leit pynshai ia kane ha kiwei pat. Ym dei ban ngin shu shaniah tang ha ki Siem bad Myntri, kiba long tang ki

nongpyniaid kam hima, hinrei ynda ngi leit nangne sha la shnong la shnong ngi dei ban leit ia pynkhih ia la ki paralok ba kin ialeh ban ia noh synniang lang, wat tang i'bai sadpoh ruh ban thaw ia ka ling Dorbar bad ban don jingdabi kum la ka jong. U Mohesh Swett, Wadar - Kane ka Dorbar ka la long m)mta la lai snem, lada ngi ia leh tang marwei marwei kata kan ym long h)mrei dei tang da ka jingiatylli lang bad ba ialeh lem baroh ka ban skhem. Bad kiwei kiwei ki paitbah. 13 tarik October, 1926 Ki Kam 1. Ka Report U Secretary President, Syiem, nongsynshar bad paitbah baroh. Nga sngewbha shibun ban ai ia ka report shaphang ka Khasi

National Dorbar. Nyngkong eh nga shu pyn-i khyndiat ia ka jingsngewshaniah ka Ri Khasi mynta ia ka Khasi National Dorbar. Kiwei pat ki Syiem kum U Syiem Nongstoin bad u Syiem Nongspung ki la iasoh lang ha ka Dorbar. Ki briew kiba sngew artatien mynshuwa ia kane ka Dorbar kumba kan nym myntoi ki la ioh-i bad ki la ngeit mynta ia ka jingkordor jong ka. Kane ka jingsngew jong ki kam long tang namar ba ki Nongsynshar ka Ri Khasi ki la iasoh lang bad ba ki briew ba sian baroh ki la ia kynpham lang, h 3 mrei ka long namar ba ka Ri ka la iohi ia ki kam ba ka Khasi National Dorbar ka la leh bad ka lah ban dang leh. Ngi ngeit skhem ba ki Syiem khyndiat eh kiba dang sah bym pat iasoh bad ka Dorbar bad katto katne ki myntri kin iasoh lang pyllun bad kane ka jingialang Doibar kaba donkam shibun eh ia ka Ri Khasi jong ngi. Ki don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba kane ka Doibar ka long kum ka Kashari ban rai man la ki mamla ba la wan na ki Syiem bad don kiba la thoh shithi sha ngi ban phah ia ki appil jtmg ki ha kane ka Dorbar na ki hima S 3 dem. Kane ka Doibar mynta hi kam lah ban leh kum ia kata ka kam. Ngim lah ban <mg 106 haduh katno kan trei kum kita ki kam ha ki snem kiba ha dien. Don kiba pyrkhat ba kan long kum ka High Court ia ka hima Khasi. Kata baroh la ka long ne kan nym long kan shong ha ka jingiakut bad ia sngewbha lang ki Syiem bad ki paitbah

na ki hima Khasi. Hynrei kaei-kaei kaba kum kata kan nym lah ban long haduh ban ngin da pyndep ban buh ha ki jingthoh ia ki Ain ki hima Khasi. Ki briew kiba sian baroh ki sngewthuh ia ka jingdonkam bad ia ka jingkyrkhu kaba lah ban mih na ki jingialang Dorbar kaba kum kane. Katba ki snem ki nangmih ka bor jong ka bad ki jingmyntoi na kane ka long kaba khraw. Sa kawei pat kaba nga dei ban ai report ka long ia ki kam (a) La iakut ha Dorbar ba la lah ba ngin phah ia ki amgut, ki rangbah ia U Mr. Joab Solomon bad ia u Mr. S.G. Nalle, hynrei u Mr. S.G. Nalle um shym lah ban leit bad u Mr. Joab Solomon u la lah ban leit tang ha ki katto katne ki jaka; bad i la ialeh shitom katba lah ban lum jingtip, hynrei nga ngeit skhem i la shem ba kane ka kam ka long kham shitom ia kaba i la pyrkhat ha kaba sdang. In sa ai hi ia la ka report. (b) Kaba nga dei ban ai report kh)mdiat ruh ka long ia ka National Hall. Hangne ha Shillong ngi la ioh ban pynlong jingialang ha Mawkhar bad Laitumkhrah, ngim shym ioh lad ban leh ha kiwei pat ki jaka. U Treasurer un sa iathuh ia phi ia ka jingmih kaba na ka bynta kane ka Hall. Khyndiat nga donkam ban ong ba ngi dei ban ialeh tyngeh ha kane ka snem ban pynmih la kumno- kumno kumba 6 hajar ban ioh sdang noh ia ka iing. Nga ngeit skhem ba ngin kham shitrhem lang ban leh ia

kane ka kam. (k) Shaphang kaba ia thoh ia ki Ain ka Edsekiwtib Komiti ka la ia minot katba don lad ban thoh pynbeit ia ka Ain- Bri-Kh)mdew. Nga ngeit ba m 3 mta ngi la kham ioh ka jingtip ba kham shai shaphang kane. Ka lah ban long ba ngin lah ban pynbeit khatduh ia kane ka ain bad ban pass noh ia ka. Nga sngewsih ba ngim don ka jingtip sa 106 tang na ki khyndiat eh ki hima - Kum na shaphang Bhawal Mawsynram bad Malaisohmat. Ha kane ka snem khlem pep ngin sa ioh ka jingtip ba paka shaphang kane. Phi lah ban ioh-i na ki kopi ba la sam ha phi baroh haduh katno na ka jingthoh pynpyrkhat ia ka ain bri-khyndew ka la kham bha ban ia kaba m3mshuwa. (d) Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la lum jingtip mh ia ka Ain- Hiar-ioh-pateng. Haba ngi la sdang ban thoh ia kane ka long kaba eh shibun ban ioh ka jingtip kaba shai, hynrei ngi la lum katba ngi la lah ban ioh, bad ha kane ka Doibar ngi wallam ha khmat jong phi ia ka jingthohpynpyrkhat ia ka ain hiar bad ioh pateng. Ngi ngeit ba ha kane hi ka Dorbar ngin ioh shibun ki jingtip shaphang kane. (e) Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la ia kren ruh shaphang ka jingiap jingim ka khaii phan ha ri Khasi bad ka dang ia pyrkhat bad wad buit da kumno ban leh ban ioh p)mialang lang ia ki nongrep baroh ha Ri Khasi. Ha ki ri

kiba sian ki don ki jingialang lang ki nongrep khnang ban p3mwan ia ka dor ha kaba biang ban nym ioh leh mon u nongthied bad nongkhaii. Ka jingeh bad ka jingiap ia ka ri jong ngi ha ka kam phan ka long namar kane ka jingioh tylli ia ka Surok Gauhati ha ka kti jong ka Motor Company; bad kane ka long kaba eh ban duh. Lehse mian-mian da kaba ngi ia pyrkhat ki lah ban mih ki lad da kiba ngin lah ban p)mleij hi ia u phan Khasi. (f ) Khyndiat nga donkam ban kren ruh ia kiei kiei kiba kane ka Dorbar ka lah ban leh hadien haba ngi la ia dep ban ia thoh ia ki ain ka ri Khasi. Ngi dei ban pyrkhat ban pynthymmai ia ka jinglong jong ki briew ban pyllait na ki jingmlien kiba pynduh pynjot ia ka ri jong ngi. Phi tip ki pata kiad ha ka ri jong ngi ki bun shibun bad ka jingdih kiad ka dang kynrei, bad ka jingdih aphin ruh ka la pynjot ia ki bun spah ki briew jong ngi. Ngi dei ban ia leh minot ban pynduh ia kine ki jingsniew lada ngin ialeh ban kiew ha ka kyrdon ki briew ki ban paw khmat ha ka pyrthei. Bad lehse don bun ki bym pat pyrkhat ia ka jingjot ia ki khun ka ri jong ngi da kawei 107 ka jingmlien kaba pynjot ia ka jabieng bad kata ka long ka jingdih Sigret ha pdeng ki khynnah. Kiwei ki ri - kum ka ri Japan, China, America bad kiwei de ki don ka jingialeh kaba jur ban pyllait ia la ki khun na kane ka

bih ba pynjot ia ka jabieng ki khynnah bad khynnah skul. Lehse ha kawei ka por haba ngi la ia pyrkhat shaphang kine ngan sa loh lad ban pyn-i ia ka jingpynjot kaba ka bih Sigret ka la leh ha ki bun ki bynta ka pyrthei, katba mynta hi don bun ki jingialang paitbah kiba ialeh thma pyrshah ia kane. Kane ka Dorbar ka lah ruh ban pynmih ha kane ka ri ia ki jingtrei kam ban pynroi ia la ka ri ha ka t3mgka ka peisa ha ka spah ka phew bad ha ka jingstad jingnang da kaba pyrkhat lad ban pynroi ha kano-kano ka rukom ia ka jinghikai kot ha ka ri jong ngi. Ngim dei ban tharai ba haba la dep kaba iathoh ia ki katto katne ki ain ka ri Khasi ka Dorbar lehse kan nym donkam shuh. Em! Kane ka jingiathoh ain ka long tang ka nongrim ba ngi ia tei ha kaba yn sa p}mlong hadien ia ka jingtei baheh bad ba itynnad. To ngin ia duwai ia U Blei Trai Kynrad U Nongthaw ia ka bneng bad ia ka khyndew ba un kyrkhu bad un ialam ia ngi bad un ai buit bad jingsngewthuh ha ngi baroh ba ngin ioh ban k3mtiew ia la ka ri ha ki kyrdon ba bha baroh. 2 . Ka jingkren bad report jong ka Treasurer ia ka jingioh bad jinglut jong ka Khasi National Dorbar. la kine ki jinglut kiba ngi pynlut ha kaba trei ia ki kam jong ka Dorbar ngi ioh na ki s)mniang kiba ngi ioh man ka snem. Lada ngim ioh synniang man ka snem ngim lah ban p3miaid

ia ki kam. Kane ka k2un jong ka Dorbar ka long khamtam na ka bynta ka ri baroh kawei ym dei tang shi bynta jong ka ri, kumta ngi ia sngewthuh hi ba ka jinglut ka long kaba khraw kum ha kaba shon ia ki Proceedings jong ka Dorbar bad ia ki jingthoh bad pynsngewthuh ia ki paitbah kiba sha nongkyndong shaphang kane ka Dorbar, lymda kumta ki member jong kane ka Dorbar kin nym roi kin nang duna 106 nang duna pjmban haduh ba kin da sah sa tang khyndiat. Na ka bynta kane baroh donkam ka fund bad kumta ngi baroh kiba kitkhia na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ka ri to ngin ia ai kylluid ia ka synniang jong ka Dorbar. Don ki ban bakla shaphang artylli ki Fund kiba ngi don, ka Fund na ka bynta ka jinglut ha kaba pyniaid ia ka kam Dorbar bad ka Building Fund, kaba na ka bynta ban thaw ia ka ling Dorbar. Na kane ka Fund ling Dorbar ym lah ban pynlut ei- ei lymda ioh ka bor kaba thikna. (U Treasurer u la report ia ka jingioh bad jinglut jong ka Dorbar kumba la shon sha dien Appendix C, bad u la pule de ia ki kyrteng jong ki ba la siew na ka bynta ka Building Fund Appendix D). 4. Ki jingkren na ka bynta ka iing Dorbar. Mr. Joab Solomon - President bad rangbah - Nga sngewbha shibun eh ia phi ba phi la sngew donkam ban phah briew sha ki hima ban leit tohkit shaphang ki rukom jong ka ri bad

ban pynkhih de ia u paitbah ban ia ai synniang na ka bynta ban shna ka ling Dorbar bad ba phi la jied ia nga bad ia I Mr. S.G. Nalle ban leit na ka bynta kine. Ngi sngew burom shibun ia phi ka Dorbar na ka bynta kane. Ha u November 1925 ngi la iakut ban leit shuwa sha Sohra ka jaka u President uba nyngkong, hynrei ngi la ioh khubor ba I Syiem im don ha shnong, bad kumta ngi la kut ban leit sha Khyrim ka jaka jong u President jong ngi. Ngi ioh sngew ha kata ka por ba I Syiem i don shaphang Lyngkhat. Te kawei ka jingeh ka la long ba ym shym la lah ban ioh ia ki Proceedings, bym pat dep shon bad I Mr. Nalle ruh i la ialeh ban pynkloi ban pyndep ia ki Proceedings bad ka Plan jong ka ling Dorbar. Kumta la P 5 mtud. Te ha u bnai December I Mr. Nalle pat i la don ki kam ki bym lah ban lait. Bad kumta im shym lah ban leit, bad nga la dei ban leit marwei. Nga la poi ha Lyngkyrdem bad nga la ia kynduh ia I Syiem Khynnah na Mawpdang iba la wan ban ap ia I Syiem hangta. Ngi la ia pynlong Dorbar hangta bad nga la batai ia ka jingdonkam ban ioh ia la ka ling Dorbar, bad ki myntri baroh ki la ia pynpaw ba kin kit khia ban ia 106 synniang peisa na ka bynta kane. Nangto pat nga la poi ha Nongjri bad hangta nga la kyntu ia ki Myntri ba kin ia kit khia ia kane ka kam jong ka Dorbar, kumba ki ruh ki long ki Khasi kiba donkam ia ki ain bad ki rukom Khasi. Nangta nga la wan phai noh sha Shillong.

Ha u Januaiy 1926 pat nga la iashem bad I Mr. Nalle bad nga la ia kyntu ia i ba in ia leit ha kane ka kynti, hynrei namar ba i trei ka kam muktiar ha ling Kashari im lah satia ban leit namar ba don ki kam; te 1 la long ia nga ba nga dei ban leit hi biang sa shiwat. Nga la poi ha Mahadeb bad nangto haba nga sah miet nga la pynsngewthuh ia ki briew hangto shaphang ka National Dorbar bad ka jingdonkam jong ka. Nga la poi pat sha Mawlong bad nga shem ba hangto ka long kaba eh shibun ban pynlong Dorbar namar ba ki Sordar bad ki briew ki iabeh ia ka trei ka ktah. Nga la donkam ban sah bun sngi hangto. Nga sngew ha lade ba ka kam jong nga haba nga leit kumne ka long ban ialeh ban pynsngewthuh ia ki briew shaphang ka jingdonkam jong ka National Dorbar bad shaphang ka jingdonkam ban ioh ia la ka ling Dorbar. Te 3 mda lah ki Sordar ki ong ba kin da pynlong Dorbar pat ma ki hi. Nga la ioh ka report na ki ba ki ong ba kin ia synniang tnum iing ba kawei pa kawei ka iing kan don bynta. Nangta nga leit sha Laitkynsew. Hangta nga la shem ba ka long Presbiteri ha Nongwar bad kito kiba iadei member jong ka Khasi National Dorbar kim lah ban pyllait por. Kumta ka por ka la tud pat. Ynda nangta nga leit sha Sheila bad nga la ia kynduh hangto bad U Rev. J.J.M. Nichols-Rcy. La pynlong Dorbar ha Hat Phali bad ma nga bad I Mr. Nichols-Roy ngi la iakren bad pyni ia ka jingdonkam jong ka Khasi National Dorbar bad ia ka jingdonkam de ban ioh ka iing Dorbar. Ngi

la ia tohkit de shaphang ki rukom. Nangta pat don ki shnong kiba dang pan por ki ong ba kin da ia pynlong Dorbar ha la shnong shuwa. Ngi la ia buh ban long Dorbar pat ha Phali ha u February. Nga la leit nangto sha Mawdon bad hangta ruh ki ong ba kin ia pynlong Dorbar ha la ki shnong ki shnong. La pynlong ka Dorbar ha Hat Mawdon bad nga la ioh lad de ban kren bad pynsngewdiuh ia u paitbah shaphang 110 ka National Dorbar. Nga la leit biang sha Sheila h 3 mrei namar ba don ki kam ia pynbeit pud, ym lah satia ban ia p 3 mlong Dorbar, nangta nga la wan phai noh sha Shillong. Nga la niut ban leit biang sha Shelia kumba la iakut ban long Doibar ha u February, hynrei nga ioh sngew ba la p)mkylla noh ia ka por kumta nga la sangeh noh. Ha kane ka jingleit nga shem ba don kiba la pynpoi khubor sha ki shnong ki shnong ki ong ba kane ka Dorbar ka mut ban knieh noh ia ka bor jong ki Siem bad ki Myntri. Nga la ialeh ban pynsngewthuh ia ki briew ba kane ka Dorbar kam mut kumta h)mrei ban nang pynkhraw ia ka bor ki Siem bad ki Myntri, bad ba kin ioh pat ia ka bor bad ka burom jong ki kaba mynshiwa. Ka don ka Dorbar kaba kum kane sha ri Phareng ba ki khot ka League of Nations. U don u President bad ki Syiem jong ki ri Phareng ki long member ha kata, h)mrei ki jingsynshar ha la ki hima-hima ki long hi hapoh ka bor jong la ki Syiem jong ki hi. Ka long kaba eh shibun ban

pynsngewthuh ia u paitbah. Ynda hadien la shem ba la long ka jinglut kaba khraw ban leit kylleng ki hima kumne bad ka Executive Committee ka la iakut ban pynduh noh ia kane ka jingleit. Nga la ai de ka diary shaphang kane ka jingleit jong nga. Mr. Rash Mohon Roy - Ngam shym lah satia ban wan poi sha kane ka Dorbar la ka la long la kham siem, hynrei nga iohi ia ki lynti kiba bha shisha kiba kane ka Dorbar ka ia leh bad nga da sngewnguh shibun eh ia ki Rangbah kiba long ki nongialam bad ia ki Syiem kiba ia kit khia ia kane ka Dorbar, kum U Syiem ka Hima Sohra bad U Syiem ka Hima Khyrim. Nga kwah ban ong hangne ha khmat ka Dorbar shaphang ki Syiem kane ka Ri Khasi jong ngi ba kat kum ka jingtip jong nga ki Syiem jong ngi naduh ka snem 1829 ki la don ka jingiateh kular bad ka Kompani Bhadur (East India Company). Ha kaba nyngkong eh U Mr. David Scott uba la long u Rangbah ka Kompani Bhadur u la iathoh ka kot kular (Agreement) bad u Duwan Singh Syiem ka Hima Sohra bad naduh kita ki por haduh U Suba Singh S)riem bad U Ramsingh Syiem kiba la mih bteng hadien, kim ju ioh Sanod ne tip ei-ei 111 ruh ia kata ka Sanod kumno bad kaba long kumno. Ynda ki la long ki Syiem ka Hima Sohra ki la shu pynneh bad pynskhem tang ia ki kular kiba la lah don naduh kiba mynshuwa ki Syiem.

Haba u Ram Singh Syiem ka Hima Sohra u la iap noh, ki khadar kur Sohra ha ka Dorbar ki la ong ba U Bor Singh u para jong u Ramsingh u dei ban kiew ha ka khet Syiem jong ka Hima Sohra, hyntei U Bor Singh namar ba u la kylla noh sha ka niam Kristan, um treh ban kiew ha ka khet Siem kat kum ka niam bad ka rukom Khasi. Te ki khadar kur Sohra ha ka Dorbar ki la jied noh ia U Hajon Manik Syiem ha ka snem 1875 uba iadei shi para ar kmie bad U Bor Singh ban long U Syiem ha ka Hima Sohra, ka Sorkar Bhadur ruh ka la ynjur ia ka rai ki Khad-ar kur Sohra. Ynda haba u Hajon Manik Syiem ka Hima Sohra u la long ha ka khet Syiem, te ki Sorkar Bhadur ki la ai ia u da ka Sanod kaba la soi da U Lad Saheb Bakhraw eh na Calcutta (Viceroy and Governor General of India) bad naduh kata ka por ka la duh noh ka jingpynskhem ia ki kot kular (Agreement) haduh kine ki sngi ba ngi ioh-i mynta. Ngi shem mynta ba ia ka Sanod ki Syiem ka Ri Khasi jong ngi la soi noh sa tang ki Komishnor Saheb. Ngi ngeit lehse hadien kan poi ka por ba ia ki Sanod ki Syiem yn soi sa tang da ki Ophisar kiba kham poh, lehse da u Sub Deputy Collector. Ngi kyrpad ia ki Syiem bad ia ki Hima Syiem baroh ba kin ia pyrkhat kham kloi ia kine ki jingjia ha kane ka Ri Khasi jong ngi. Nga kwah ruh ban ong ia ki Syiem bad ki Nongsynshar ka Ri jong ngi lada kim ia long bad tylli kawei, wat ia ka burom

kaba ngi dang bat mynta ruh lehse ngin duh noh. Ki Syiem jong ngi ki don la ki bor bad nga apil ha ka Dorbar ba kaba nyngkong eh kaba ngi dei ban leh ka long ban bat ia ka bor jong ki Syiem jong ngi. Haba ki Syiem kim don shuh la ka bor la jong, ka long ha ngi ka jingjah burom kaba khraw shibun eh. Ko Sjdem ba donburom kane ka Dorbar ka long na ka bynta jong phi bad na ka b 3 mta ki khun ki hajar ka Hima, ba phi dei ban kit khia bha shibun shaphang kane. 112 Ki don ki Syiem kiba leh bor bad khem shibun eh ia la ki khun ki hajar hapoh la ki hima jong ki, ki jinglaitluid ki paitbah ki la nang khim nang khim. Te ki Syiem ki dei ban kham pyrkhat ia kane namar ba kane ka jingleh bor mian- mian kan pyntroin ia la ki khun ki hajar bad ka Hima ruh kan shu shitom. Nga sngew ba ka long kaba donkam shibun eh ba ki Syiem kin ia thaw noh la ki Skul, ki skul ha la ki hima baroh bad ba ki khynnah ruh kin ia ioh ka jingnang pule, nangthoh, ynda ngi la don kum kita ki Skul ha la ki hima baroh, te ngin pynpule ia kine de ki Ain kiba la ia thaw ha kane ka Dorbar ha kita ki Skul. Ngi ai khublei da ka jingsngewnguh kaba khraw shibun eh ia U Syiem ka Hima Khyrim uba la lah ban plie Skul ha Smit bad uba la leh bha shibun eh ia ki khynnah Skul. Nga kyrpad ba ki Syiem baroh kin ialeh kumjuh hi kumba u la leh U Syiem ka Hima Khyrim.

Shaphang ka iing paitbah (National Hall) nga sngew ba ka long kaba dei ban ioh ia ka bad nga kyrpad ia phi ki Syiem ba phin kham ia kit khia shaphang kane, phin nym ia khmih lynti eh ia kiba rit kiba ria. Ka long kaba eh ia ki ban kyrshan ia kane. Ka long ruh kaba donkam eh ban pynkhih ban ia thaw noh ka Kompani jong ngi ki khun Khasi khnang ba ka Ri Khasi jong ngi hadien kan ioh lad ban long riewspah bad ba ngin ioh ruh ka iing paitbah kaba bha. Nga kwah ban iathuh ha ka Dorbar ba nga la ioh lad ban ia shem ia U Saheb Deputi Komishnor ha ka por ba ki ia leit ki nongrep bad ki nongkhaii phan kiba la iaduh ne luksan shibun eh na ka bynta ba la sah u phan ha ki kudam buh phan namar ba ki Lori kim lah satia ban kit ia u phan uba la poi hapoh Sor Shillong bad ba ka dor ruh ka la hiar than eh. Haba ki Khasi ki la iathuh ia la ka jingjynjar jong ki ha U Saheb Deputi Komishnor, te U Saheb ruh u la sngew lem shibun shaphang ka jingduh jong ngi ki Khasi bad u la kular ban iarap ia ngi da kumno ban ngin nym duh ha ka jingkhaii phan, u la leh ruh ia kata bad U Lat Saheb ruh la mynjur ba ki Lori kin kham bun bad ban wan rwing na Gauhati. 113 Maphi ki Syiem ki L)mgdoh, ki Wadar bad ki Sordar baroh phi dei ban ia kit khia ia kane ka Dorbar lymda phi ia kit khia ma phi, kane ka Dorbar kan nym long ei ei ruh hadien. Nga kyntu ruh ia phi ki Syiem ki Lyngdon ba phin ia lum Dorbar

ha la ki Hima ban pynkhih shaphang kane ka Dorbar bad ban ioh ruh ka iing Dorbar kaba bha. Nga kyrpad ia phi ki Syiem ruh ban nym leh kaei-kaei ka ban pynduh ia ka jinglaitluid u paitbah. Rev. J.J.M. NicholS'Roy - I Bah Rash Mohon Roy i la kren shaphang ban pynlong Kompani Khasi ban pynroi ia ka jingkhaii bad shaphang u phan. Menon, Secretary jong ka Sorkar India, Ministry of States ha ka kot jong u, 'The Story of the Integration of the Indian States', u ong - "THE KHASI HILL STATES , a tribal area in Assam, were twenty-five in number. The chiefs of these States, known as Siems, were generally elected by the people: a number of them were Christians. Before the transfer of power, the Crown Representative's relations with these Staes were conducted through the Governor of Assam. These States did not accede to India on 15*'’ August 1947. the old practice continued, by

which the Government of Assam administered these areas on behalf of the Government of India under the Indian (Foreign Jurisdiction Order in Council). Later in the year these States, which had meanwhile formed a federation of their own, executed an Agreement continuing in force, with certain exceptions, existing administrative arrangements with the Dominion of India and the Province of Assam. Thereafter, the rulers individually and collectively acceded to the Indian Union. The Instrument of Accession, subject to the provision of the Agreement, empowered the Dominion Legislature to make laws for the Khasi Hill State in respect of any matter. The future of these States under the new Constitution was the subject of prolonged discussion between the States Ministry and the the Siems and their advisers, the Reverend Nichols-Roy being their chief spokesman. The people in the States wished to preserve their tradition and customs as far as possible. They were anxious to maintain their autonomy, and were opposed to the idea of outright merger with Assam. The Government of India ultimately deaded that the district councils in the tribal areas should be given a large measure of autonomy. Detailed and specific provisions for the governance of the Khasi Hill States and odier tribal areas of Assam were included in the Sixth Schedule to the Indian Constitution".* Ka District Council kaba nyngkong eh jong ka United Khasi-

But we find that the Sixth Schedule does not provide adequate safeguards for all those rights, privileges and decrocratic institutions. The Consitution Making Duihar of the Khasi States as far back as 1940 had foreseen this and demanded a separate schedule for the whole District of Khasi Jaintia Hills. The purpose of the embodiment of the Sixth Schedule in the Constitution is that the Tribal people should decide for themselves and not to have things decided for them. But the introduction of arbitrary nominations to the District Council is foreign to the democratic traditions of the Khasis and at the same time defeats that very purpose. As a protest against this innovation which is a challenge to the

feelings of the Khasis, after unsuccessful attempts to obtain redress from die Government of Assam, a procession headed by students was taken out on the 27* June 1952, the day of inauguration of the District Council. The procession was peaceful one and free of all intentions of causing breach of public peace. The Government of Assam met the procession by a well-prepared force of armed police who engaged the demonstrators with tear-gas and lathi charge, a fact which gave rise to a just resentment of the Khasis. Fourty three of the demonstrators were arrested while public resentment was cooled down by interference of Khasi leaders who love and work for peace. Strangely enough, a few minutes after the above incident the procession was allowed to reform itself and to proceed, this time with a much large crowd through the main roads of Shillong which were previously prohibited areas. Thus the 'right of expression' of the Khasis was cut and their feelings of insecurity aggravated. In addition to the imposition of nomintation to the District Council the existence of the following provisions, among others, have served to increase the sense of insecurity and fears of the Khasis :- 1. That assent to the laws passed by the District Council will be given by the Govenor not acting in his discreation. 2. The exclusion of Shillong for all practical purposes from the jurisdiction of the District Council. 3. That licences and leases for the purpose of prospecting for. 244

and the extraction of minerals from our District are to be granted by the Assam Government. 4. That large portion of the income derived from the District has to be shared with the State Government. The partition of India has extensively hard hit the Southern portion of Khasi Hills. People in that area were and used to be prosperous and rich. The partition brought cessation of trade with Sylhet bad East Bengal and the once valuable and wealth producing commodities became useless and unusable with the consequence that these people were reduced to dire poverty. The attempt to air- lift the produce last year could only transport a microscopic portion of it. The area does not produce life-maintaining commodities and the people are suffering from want and starvation. Driven by hunger a nuber of our kith and kin (more than 1000) was reported to have separated from us and migrated to Pakistan. This is heart- paining to us as a people and likely a danger to the State. The proposed attempt of the Assam Government to supply rice to those people at control rate will be of no value because they have no more purchasing power. Their condition is no better than those of refugees. We opposed the proposal of making Assamese the State language of Assam. As Hill Tribes we are having to learn besides our own vernacular, English and Hindi which is athe lingua franca of India; addition of Assamese over and above these will be very heavy to our boys and girls in schools and colleges.

The Hills of Assam are contiguous and the people inhabiting them are more or less of the same stock, having affinity of culture, ways of life, character and in many other respects. They have common understanding, common fear of encroachment and exploitation by major communities. The unification of these hills under one administration and tmder the Indiem Union will, it is hoped, meet the aspirations of all the Tribal people. We again welcome you with or National invocation of blessing. KI RITI KA KHASI NATIONAL DORBAR Jinglamphrang Mynba la seng ia ka Khasi National Dorbar ha ka 4"' September 1923, ha ka jingialang ki Syiem, ki Lyngdoh, ki Wahadadars, ki Myntri bad ki Rangbah na ki dong ka Ri Khasi baroh ha ka nongbah Shillong, la thaw ruh ia ki rule ban pyniad ia ka Dorbar kiba pynkhreh ia ka Ri ban iabit bad iadei bad ka jingsynshar ha kato ka por kaba long ka jingsynshar thymmai ia ka Ri India hapoh ka Reformed Scheme ba la pynwan da ka Sorkar Bilat. Ka jingialang ka la iohi ia ka jingdonkam ba ka Ri ka dei ban long tylli kawei khnang ba kan im bad lah ban kiew irat ha ka jingtip jingshemphang, ha ka imsuk imsain bad ha ka synshar khadar de. Ha ka snem 1935 la pynkylla thymmai ia ki rukom synshar ki Sorkar Phareng ha Ri India da ka Government of India Act 1935, bad ka jingkylla ka la ktah ruh ia ki Hima Khasi bad Jaintia, la ka laid suki jai. Ka Khasi National Dorbar da kaba peit bniah ia ki jingjia bad ki dak ki shin ki jingkylla ha Ri India bad hapoh iing la jong, ha ka jingialang bah ha ka 4"’ June 1945, ka la pynbeit ia la ki rule pyniaid kam khnang ban dup iadei bad ka por bad ka la jer kyrteng ia kita ki rule "Ki Riti". Naduh ka snem 1947, 15 tarik August ka Ri India ka la lait na ka jingsynshar u Phareng bad ka la long Independent bad hapdeng ki 8 snem, ki jingkylla ba khraw ba mih na ka Independence ki la wan. la ka ri lum jong ngi la buh da ka Constitution ka Ri India

Bad u la p 3 mshai ruh kumno ban thoh ban ai ia ki Sanad jong H bad nangta ruh la sdang kham shynna ka jingai Sanad ia ki Syiem bad nongsynshar jong ngi baroh. Don kiba dei ban ai Sanad da U Lat bah ka ri India bad don kiba dei ban ai Sanad da u khlieh jong ka ri Assam kum U Chief Commissioner ne Governor jong ka jylla Assam. Katba tip ma nga ia ka Sanad jong U Klur Singh Syiem Kh)rrim Nongkrem ruh la ai bad soi da U Lat bah jong ka ri India. Bad hadien ynda la iap U Ram Singh ha ka 23"* July 1875 u la long Syiem U Hajon Manik da ka jingialeh ne iaknieh Syiem na U Bor Singh uba long u hynmen hynrei ym shym la thung Syiem da ki 12 kur namar ba u kylla Kristan. Kumta ia ka Sanad jong u Hajon Manik lada ngam bakla, la ai bad soi da U Chief Commissioner bad ynda ha ka 24**’ May 1901 u la iap u Hajon Manik Syiem bad la thung Syiem da u Roba Singh

Syiem, ia ka Sanad jong u ruh la ai bad doskot da U Chief Commissioner hi. Bad ia bun ki Syiem Khasi kiba long Syiem jan jan ha kita ki por la doskot hi da u Chief Commissioner. Hynrei ynda iap u Syiem Roba Singh ha ka SO*** November 1918 bad la long Syiem da u Join Manik S)dem ha ka snem 1919 ia ka Sanad jong u la ai bad doskot da u Comissioner bad kumta ia kiwei kiwei ki Syiem ruh kiba long Syiem hadien bad jan ia kata. la ka Sanad U Olim Singh Syiem Khyrim ruh la doskot sa da u Commissioner hi. Kumta ka la mih ka jingdiaw bad jingpynkhih jingpyrkhat ha ki Syiem bad paitbah kumno kane kan long. Ka dei ba ngin ia pyrkhat ia kane namar kine ki daw. 1. Namar ba ngi kham sngew donburom bad sngewhun haba ia ki Sanad jong ki Syiem jong ngi la doskot da u Chief Commissioner ne U Governor jong ka Jylla ne Province ka ri Assam bad katno kaba sngewsuk mynsiem ne sngew donburom haba ia ki Sanad jong ki Syiem jong ngi katto katne dang ai bad doskot da U Lat bah jong ka ri India. 2. Sngew syier ba ioh sa katto katne ki snem yn doskot ia ki Sanad jong ki Syiem jong ngi sa da kiba nang kham shapoh. 3. Ba ioh da kaba nang pynhiar kumne ha kaba doskot ia ki Sanad lehse ba ioh nang pynhiar ia ka bor ki Syiem ia kaba ngi ieit eh bad ngi sngew sarong ba ka Sorkar ka

dang sngewbha ban bat ia ki kular bad pynneh haduh mynta ia ki hok jong ngi. 4. Ba ngi sngew lyngngoh ruh ba ha ki Sanad jong ki Syiem la pynrung ki jingiakut kiba ki Syiem kim don bor ban thoh ne ai, kata ia ki khyndew ki shyiap ne ki khlaw ki btap jong ki khun ki hajar khlem ka mynjur jong ki trai. Ngi ngeit ba haba ka Sorkar Phereng (British Government) ka la wan rung ha ri jong ngi ka iohi ba ngi long ki jaid briew kiba pher na ki lok ha ri dkhar; lymda kumta kan nym da la iathoh ki Treaty ne kular kum kito bad ngi haba bad kiwei ki para marjan kam shym leh. Bad ka jingshaniah ka Phareng ia ngi ki Khasi ruh kam shym long kaba lehnohei. Haba shaniah hok ia'ngi bad bat hok ia ki kular ngi ki Khasi ruh ngim shym haram ia kata ka jingshaniah. La haba khmih hato ngin leh aiu heit ma ngi ka jaid bynriew kaba khyndiat eh. Hynrei khmih ynda haba ka jingdonkam kaba ka Sorkar jong ngi ka don ha ka khim khak kum ha ka thma German kumno ym dei ma ngi ki Khasi na ki jaid bynriew baroh ka n Assam kiba la ai jingiarap ia ka Sorkar kham palat? Yn ia pyrshang kat kum ka jingbun u briew (in proportion to our population) ym don kawei ka jaidbriew kaba la ai briew sha ka kam thma kat ngi ki Khasi. Ngi ai briew sha France, Mesopotamia bad shawei bad ha ka kam kit maw shynrut lei lei na Maweit sha Boko bun hajar ne bun phew hajar. Haba khmih hangne ka paw ia ka jingstad ne jingshai khmat jong

ki Phereng ba ki iohi ba kum ia kino ki briew kiba bit ban shaniah; bad ka la wan jia ha kane ruh ba ka jingshaniah jong ki ia ngi naduh kaba sdang ka la wan ur long mynta ba kam shym bijai ei. la ki Phereng hi ngim shym tieng bad khamtam haba dang sah ki Sahep kiba rim. Hynrei kaba ngi tieng ba ioh ynda slem la shai khyllait ki Saheb kiba shaniah bad sngewlem ia ngi bad khamtam haba khih ka ri India ban kylla kumne ba ioh shu lymbub ruma ia ngi bad ioh kin duh ki hok bad ki bor jong ki Syiem jong ngi bad ki hok jong ngi ki khun ki hajar kiba long trai ia ki khyndew bad ba sain bad buh ia ki Syiem. Ka Report jong u Secretary President, rangbah bad paitbah baroh, nga sngewbha ban ai la kane ka report shaphang ki kam jong ka National Dorbar Naduh katei ka Dorbar kaba lai ka Executive Committee ka la trei katto katne ki kam kiba don kam. Ngi la pyrkhat lad kumno ban pynsted ia ka jingtrei jong ka Dorbar. Kumba la rai ha ka dorbar ba la lah ngi la phah ia ki Proceedings jong ka dorbar ha ki Syiem bad ki hima baroh, bad ngi la thoh da ki shithi ba kin ia pynlong dorbar bad kin ia ai jingmut shapahng ki ain artylli kiba la thoh bad ngi la ong de ia ki ba kin ia phah briew ban iashem bad ka Eksekiwtib Komiti. Ha ka 28 bad 29 tarik September de ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la ialang biang ban iashem bad kiba ngi la khot ban wan na ki hima bad ioh ia pynbeit ia ki Ain artylli - ka Ain jinglong-

79 khun-ka hima bad ka Ain bri khyndew; bad ngi la ialeh katba lah ban pynbeit. Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la ia wad jingtip de shaphang ka Ain Jingioh-pateng ha ri Khasi; bad ngi la pyrkhat ruh ban iathoh noh ia kane ka Ain bad ka Ain jingiateh hima (constitution). Ngi kyrmen na ka jingtip ba ngi lah ban lum ha kane ka Dorbar ngin lah ban pynmih ha ka jingthoh la kine ki am ha kawei pat ka dorbar ka ban sa long. Kane ka jingthoh ia kine ki Ain ka long ka kam baneh ba ngi ia trei; bad kine ki jingthoh kin long ki ain jong ka ri. Ka nongrim ba ngi trei hadien kan skhem haba ngi la dep ban thoh ia kine ki ain baroh. Kawei na ki kam kaba ngi la sngewkhia ha kane ka por ka long ka plan jong ka ling Dorbar kaba ngin thaw ha Mawkhar. Ha ka dorbar ba la lah ngi la shimti ia ka jaka ba khot National Hall ha Mawkhar. Kumta ka jaka ban thaw la ka Ing-dorbar ngi la don lupa. Nalor kata ruh u Rai Sahib Hormu Rai Diengdoh u la pyntip ha ngi ba don kumba 4 ne 5 spah tyngka ba la ioh na ka bai wai iing ka National Hall, bad la kine ki tyngka i sa ai ha ka National Dorbar namar ka ling Dorbar. la kane in sa kren hi haba ngin la kren shaphang ka plan bad ka estimate ne ka jingkhein antad ia ka jinglut Ka Eksekiwtib Komiti ka la khein ba ka jinglut kan long tang Rs. 11,000. Bad ngin sa ia kren hangne shaphang kane, bad

lada ka dorbar ka pynskhem ia kane te ngin ia thaw lad kumno ban pynmih ia kine ki tyngka. Ngi kyrmen ha kane ka dorbar ba ngin lah ban pynkut ia ka Ain jinglong-khun-ka-hima, bad ngin ioh jingtip shuh shaphang ka Ain-bri-khyndew. Ka don sa kawei ka jingpyrkhat jong ka Eksekiwtib Komiti kaba ngi la sngew ba ka long kaba donkam eh. Kane ka long ba ngin jied amgut ki rangbah ban phah kylleng ha ki hima ban ai lekshor bad ban wad jingtip shaphang ka rukom jongioh pateng, shaphang ka jingiateh hima bad shaphang kiwei kiwei de. Ngi mut ban thoh na ka Eksekiwtib Komiti 80 bun ki jingkylli ba kine ki rangbah kiba phah sha ki hima kin kylli na ki rangbah ki hima baroh bad kin thoh ia ka jubab jong ki, bad nangta ngin sa ia thoh beit kat kita ki jingtip ia ki rukom ban long ki ain kiba neh. Ka Dorbar kan jied ia kine ki rangbah lada ka ia mynjur ban phah ia ki namar kine ki kam. Bad sa kawei pat, kine ki rangbah kin pynsngewthuh ia ki paitbah ia ka jingdonkam ban long member ha kane ka Dorbar bad kin phah soi ia ki kot member. Bad kin kren de shaphang ka ling Dorbar ba kin ialeh ban pynkhih ia ki paitbah ka ri ban ia ai synniang namar kane ka ling Dorbar. Nga hi nga sngew ba ka long kaba donkam eh ba ngin phah rangbah kumne. Lada ka Dorbar kan mynjur ia kane te kan

ai ruh katto katne tyngka ban siew ia ka jinglut jong kine ki ban leit kumne kylleng ha ka hima Khasi. Bad lehse kata ka tyngka kan ym duna ia ka Rs. 250. Te hynrei kane ka jinglut ka lah ban mih na ki tyngka ban ioh na ki hima na kiba long member bad na kiba ia synniang ia ka ling Dorbar. Nga kyrmen ba phm ia buh jingmut shaphang kane ha kane ka Dorbar. Ia ka jingioh bad jinglut mynta ka snem kat kaba la ai U Treasure la buh hadien (Appendix A). Shuwa ba ngan wai noh nga sngew nga donkam khyndiat ban kren. Nga iohi ba kane ka Dorbar ka la nang-roi nagskhem bad ki paitbah ka ri ki nangkhmih ha ka ia kiei-kiei kiba bha ki ban nangmih hadien. Ki briew kiba artatien ki la nang sngew shngain. Ki briew ki ban trei ha ka Dorbar ruh ngi ioh-i ki nangmih. Ngi donkam mynta tang ba ngin ia pynsngewthuh paralok ia ka jingdonkam kane ka Dorbar. Kat shaba ngi leit ngi dei ban kyntu ia ki paitbah ban ia soi ia ki phorm member. Nga iohi ba don hangne bun ki rangbah bad ki student na ki skul bah, te ngan )nn da donkam ban da batai ia kine, nga shu pule beit ia ki ktien na ka kitab: "Introduction to Political Science" kumne : "Among the more conspicuous merits of the federal system may be noted, first of all, that it affords a means of uniting into a powerful state commonwealths more

or less diverse in character . . . without existinguishing wholly their separate existences... Federation has been the means of bringing together many petty states in the past which ... for this, would have remained forever apart. It has thus proved a powerful unifying force where other forms of government have repelled. Again, it excels all other forms of government in the effectiveness with which it combines the advantages of national unity and power with those of local autonomy. It secures at the same time all the advantages of uniformity in the regulation of affairs of general concern with those of diversity in the regulation of local affairs. Instead of concentrating the power of the state in a single organ or set of organs, as is the case in the unitary state, federalism distributes it between a common central government and a number of local government, and thus prevents the rise of a single despotism absorbing all political power and menacing the liberties of the people". Menon, Secretary jong ka Sorkar India, Ministry of States ha ka kot jong u, 'The Story of the Integration of the Indian States', u ong - "THE KHASI HILL STATES , a tribal area in Assam, were twenty-five in number. The chiefs of these States, known as Siems, were generally elected by the people: a number of them were Christians. Before the transfer of power, the Crown Representative's relations with these Staes were conducted through the Governor of Assam. These States did not accede to India on 15*'’ August 1947. the old practice continued, by

which the Government of Assam administered these areas on behalf of the Government of India under the Indian (Foreign Jurisdiction Order in Council). Later in the year these States, which had meanwhile formed a federation of their own, executed an Agreement continuing in force, with certain exceptions, existing administrative arrangements with the Dominion of India and the Province of Assam. Thereafter, the rulers individually and collectively acceded to the Indian Union. The Instrument of Accession, subject to the provision of the Agreement, empowered the Dominion Legislature to make laws for the Khasi Hill State in respect of any matter. The future of these States under the new Constitution was the subject of prolonged discussion between the States Ministry and the the Siems and their advisers, the Reverend Nichols-Roy being their chief spokesman. The people in the States wished to preserve their tradition and customs as far as possible. They were anxious to maintain their autonomy, and were opposed to the idea of outright merger with Assam. The Government of India ultimately deaded that the district councils in the tribal areas should be given a large measure of autonomy. Detailed and specific provisions for the governance of the Khasi Hill States and odier tribal areas of Assam were included in the Sixth Schedule to the Indian Constitution".* Ka District Council kaba nyngkong eh jong ka United Khasi-

The Khasis are entirely difierent from the plains people as they have difiierent tradition^ culture and civilization of their own. But we find that the Sixth Schedule does not provide adequate safeguards for all those rights, privileges and decrocratic institutions. The Consitution Making Duihar of the Khasi States as far back as 1940 had foreseen this and demanded a separate schedule for the whole District of Khasi Jaintia Hills. The purpose of the embodiment of the Sixth Schedule in the Constitution is that the Tribal people should decide for themselves and not to have things decided for them. But the introduction of arbitrary nominations to the District Council is foreign to the democratic traditions of the Khasis and at the same time defeats that very purpose. As a protest against this innovation which is a challenge to the

feelings of the Khasis, after unsuccessful attempts to obtain redress from die Government of Assam, a procession headed by students was taken out on the 27* June 1952, the day of inauguration of the District Council. The procession was peaceful one and free of all intentions of causing breach of public peace. The Government of Assam met the procession by a well-prepared force of armed police who engaged the demonstrators with tear-gas and lathi charge, a fact which gave rise to a just resentment of the Khasis. Fourty three of the demonstrators were arrested while public resentment was cooled down by interference of Khasi leaders who love and work for peace. Strangely enough, a few minutes after the above incident the procession was allowed to reform itself and to proceed, this time with a much large crowd through the main roads of Shillong which were previously prohibited areas. Thus the 'right of expression' of the Khasis was cut and their feelings of insecurity aggravated. In addition to the imposition of nomintation to the District Council the existence of the following provisions, among others, have served to increase the sense of insecurity and fears of the Khasis :- 1. That assent to the laws passed by the District Council will be given by the Govenor not acting in his discreation. 2. The exclusion of Shillong for all practical purposes from the jurisdiction of the District Council. 3. That licences and leases for the purpose of prospecting for. 244

and the extraction of minerals from our District are to be granted by the Assam Government. 4. That large portion of the income derived from the District has to be shared with the State Government. The partition of India has extensively hard hit the Southern portion of Khasi Hills. People in that area were and used to be prosperous and rich. The partition brought cessation of trade with Sylhet bad East Bengal and the once valuable and wealth producing commodities became useless and unusable with the consequence that these people were reduced to dire poverty. The attempt to air- lift the produce last year could only transport a microscopic portion of it. The area does not produce life-maintaining commodities and the people are suffering from want and starvation. Driven by hunger a nuber of our kith and kin (more than 1000) was reported to have separated from us and migrated to Pakistan. This is heart- paining to us as a people and likely a danger to the State. The proposed attempt of the Assam Government to supply rice to those people at control rate will be of no value because they have no more purchasing power. Their condition is no better than those of refugees. We opposed the proposal of making Assamese the State language of Assam. As Hill Tribes we are having to learn besides our own vernacular, English and Hindi which is athe lingua franca of India; addition of Assamese over and above these will be very heavy to our boys and girls in schools and colleges.

The Hills of Assam are contiguous and the people inhabiting them are more or less of the same stock, having affinity of culture, ways of life, character and in many other respects. They have common understanding, common fear of encroachment and exploitation by major communities. The unification of these hills under one administration and tmder the Indiem Union will, it is hoped, meet the aspirations of all the Tribal people. Ha ka snem 1935 la pynkylla thymmai ia ki rukom synshar ki Sorkar Phareng ha Ri India da ka Government of India Act 1935, bad ka jingkylla ka la ktah ruh ia ki Hima Khasi bad Jaintia, la ka laid suki jai. Ka Khasi National Dorbar da kaba peit bniah ia ki jingjia bad ki dak ki shin ki jingkylla ha Ri India bad hapoh iing la jong, ha ka jingialang bah ha ka 4"’ June 1945, ka la pynbeit ia la ki rule pyniaid kam khnang ban dup iadei bad ka por bad ka la jer kyrteng ia kita ki rule "Ki Riti". Naduh ka snem 1947, 15 tarik August ka Ri India ka la lait na ka jingsynshar u Phareng bad ka la long Independent bad hapdeng ki 8 snem, ki jingkylla ba khraw ba mih na ka Independence ki la wan. la ka ri lum jong ngi la buh da ka Constitution ka Ri India

ba kin long Autonomous bad ki District Councils ki la mih ha Ri Khasi-Jaintia, Ri Garo, Ri Mizo, Ri North Cachar, Ri Naga bad Ri Mikir. Na kine ki jingjia ka la nang donkam ban pyrkhat ban pynbha ia ki Riti ka Dorbar m)mta bad ter-shi-ter katba nangiaid ki por. Hapdeng kane ka por ba donkam ban pynbeit ia la ka iing ka sem ban ia iaid dur bad ki jingkylla ba la ong, ka jingrai ka Sorkar India ban phah ia ka State Re-organisation Commission ka la pynmih ha ka Ri ia ka kam kaba ka jingkhraw bad jingdonkam jong ka, ka buh shuwa sha kyndong ia kiwei pat ki kam baroh. Kumta ka long kaba donkam ban shai bad ban sngewthuh ia ka Khasi National Dorbar, bad ba ka Ri ruh kan tip kaei ka jingieng bad jingthmu jong ka. Namarkata la shu shim lang ia kine baroh na ki rai ka Doibar Bah naduh ka 1923 haduh 1954, khnang ba yn lah ban pyni ha ka pyrthei ia ka jingthmu jingieng bad jingtrei ka Khasi National Dorbar bad ba kan long ka nongrim ia ka jingpyrkhat ban nangbha katba nang iakynduh bad ki jingkylla ka jingsynshar ha ka Ri India jong ngi.
